heroHeadline: Beltsville Cyclospora Research Deadline Passes Amid Court Fight as CDC Count Holds at 19,883
heroSubtitle: USDA's court-set deadline for Agricultural Research Service staff to report to newly assigned labs outside Maryland passed Sept 21, part of the Beltsville reorganization that has already defunded two of the program's three Cyclospora research projects; litigation over the move continues, with a further hearing set for Sept 29 and a court-ordered pause deadline of Oct 2. CDC's national case count remains frozen at 19,883 lab-confirmed cases, 1,064 hospitalizations, and 2 deaths since its Sept 15 update, consistent with the agency's move to periodic rather than weekly reporting.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
